global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with tender chashu pork and menma arranged atop yellow noodles. Served in a red-and-white bowl with dragon motifs, it rests on a vibrant red surface under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: The surface is smooth, vibrant red, with subtle light reflections and a slight sheen across its curved, rounded edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon and pink floral patterns, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, and glossy, with thin noodles submerged and gently swirling beneath.
regions.meat: Chashu pork shows layered fat and lean meat, glossy surface, irregular shape with visible marbling and slight char.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curved, segmented shapes.
